The OP service billing module acts as a single billing point for charging all OP services provided by the hospital to the Outpatients. It generates different bill charges for various types of patients based on the eligible criteria. The process involves selecting the file type of the patient (OP, IP, new, or outsider), loading patient details, verifying insurance eligibility, and choosing consultation or service for billing. Payment calculations consider VAT, deductions, discounts, and advance payments. For more details, refer to the provided images: [Screenshot 1](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_112817.png) and [Screenshot 2](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_113256.png).
